# Model card: Rubric clarification

| | |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Suggest clearer wording for a rubric criterion where people and the AI agree least. |
| Workflow | hire |
| Code | `pairly_hire.analytics.calibration` |
| Prompt | `hire_rubric_clarify` version `v1`, file SHA-256 `34a41b6f7c4dee8c...` |
| Output schema | `RubricClarification` |
| Model tiers, cheapest first | `small` (anthropic `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, openai `gpt-6-luna`) then `large` (anthropic `claude-sonnet-5-5`, openai `gpt-6.1-sol`) |
| Temperature | 0.0 |
| Output token limit | 1024 |
| Confidence threshold to accept | none |

## Inputs

The criterion, its anchors and the agreement report. No candidate data.

## Outputs

`RubricClarification`: suggested wording.

## Human oversight

A suggestion never changes the rubric: a person edits it and locks a new version (second factor). A deterministic suggestion from the rubric's own anchors is always shown too.

## Limits

* Only as good as the labels people gave.
* Every call is logged in `model_calls` (prompt version and hash, model, inputs, output, tokens, cost) and fails closed: no model means a person does the step.

## Evals

No eval measures this component yet.
